title: Add 'Copiar link' and 'Mover para outro menu' actions to the page/menu three-dot dropdown
description: Address items 11 and 12 of `novas-tasks.md`. All three-dot dropdowns share `RowActionsMenu.tsx` (used by `AppHeader.tsx`'s header menu items, `SidebarTree.tsx`'s section pages, and `PageContentPage.tsx`'s tab bar). (11) Add a 'Copiar link' action to the header menu items and the section pages dropdowns, copying the public documentation URL to the clipboard — NOT the CMS edit URL. For a section page, this is `/docs/:sectionSlug/:pageSlug` (from `sections.slug`/`pages.slug`). For a header menu item, per user decision, this links to the first page of the first section under that menu (same `/docs/:sectionSlug/:pageSlug` pattern, resolved from the menu's first section/page). (12) Add a 'Mover para outro menu' action to the section pages dropdown only (not header menus, not tabs), which opens a small picker to move that page (and its tabs) to a different section/menu — only shown when 2+ menus exist. This requires a new backend mutation, since none currently supports moving a page across its parent section (existing `pages.reorder` only reorders within the same `sectionId`).
acceptanceCriteria: 'Copiar link' appears in the three-dot dropdown for header menu items and section pages (not for tabs)
Clicking 'Copiar link' on a section page copies `/docs/:sectionSlug/:pageSlug` (full origin URL) to the clipboard, with a toast confirmation

Clicking 'Copiar link' on a header menu item copies the public URL of that menu's first section's first page; if the menu has no sections/pages yet, the action is disabled with an explanatory tooltip or hidden
'Mover para outro menu' appears only in the section pages dropdown, and only when 2 or more menus exist in the workspace

Selecting a target section/menu in the move picker relocates the page (updating its `sectionId`) via a new tRPC mutation, and the page disappears from its old section's list and appears in the new one immediately
Moving a page preserves its tabs and content unchanged

steps.details: Add a 'Copiar link' `DropdownMenuItem` to `RowActionsMenu.tsx`'s usage in `SidebarTree.tsx` (section pages) and `AppHeader.tsx` (menu items), resolving the target public URL for each case and writing it via `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.

steps.description: Backend mutation for moving a page
steps.details: Add a `pages.move` (or similar) tRPC procedure that updates a page's `sectionId` to a new target section, using `protectedProcedure` consistent with other structural mutations.

Add a 'Mover para outro menu' `DropdownMenuItem` (conditionally rendered when 2+ menus exist) to `SidebarTree.tsx`'s page row dropdown, opening a small picker (menu → section) that calls the new mutation on confirm.

Copy a link for a section page and for a header menu item and confirm the clipboard contents resolve to the correct public page; move a page to a different menu/section and confirm it relocates correctly with tabs/content intact.

technicalNotes: Public URL structure: `apps/admin/src/main.tsx` defines `/docs/:sectionSlug/:pageSlug` (and `/docs/:sectionSlug/:pageSlug/:tabId`) as the public routes, distinct from the CMS edit routes `/pages/:pageId`.
`RowActionsMenu.tsx`'s own doc comment previously stated 'Mover entre seções' was intentionally excluded because no backend mutation existed for it — this task is what adds that mutation.
Header menu 'Copiar link' target resolved to the first section/page per explicit user decision, since menus have no dedicated public page of their own.
